patches.evidence: ADAC Autotest VW T-Cross 1.0 TSI OPF R-Line DSG (AT6419, the current/facelift-era test): Ladekante 71 cm above the road; the inner step to the floor is about 2 cm with the load floor up and about 17 cm with it down. The ADAC model page gives 72 cm, so the sources disagree by 1 cm.
Kofferraum-Check test 'Volkswagen VW Tiguan ab 2024': Ladekantenhöhe 74 cm, then about 1 cm further down behind the sill. The load floor cannot be lowered because of the subwoofer.
